product.name: Hamilton + DAGWorks Platform
product.description: A platform that enables data science teams to develop, produce, and maintain machine learning pipelines with enhanced ease of understanding, expression, and testability.

product.name: Lineage View
product.description: An interactive visualization tool on the DAGWorks Platform that shows how code and artifacts are connected.

product.name: Catalog View
product.description: Allows users to see and search for code and artifacts in a tabular view on the DAGWorks Platform.

product.name: Dataflow Execution Tracking
product.description: Tracks the execution of Hamilton dataflows, logging information to the DAGWorks platform for analysis and comparison.

product.name: Data Observability
product.description: Features in beta that allow users to introspect the outputs of functions for summary statistics and build alerts on them.

product.name: CI Impact Integration
product.description: An integration step that surfaces impacts and changes for a particular code change, like impacted teams and models.
